full_judgment: V. Whether, in the facts and on the circumstances of the case, the Tribunal under sections 159(2)/19(1) of the Ordinance was justified in upholding addition of the part of share .money deposit Taka 31,25,000 (refunded) as income from other sources under section 19(1) of the Ordinance inasmuch as, the assessee applicant received the share money deposit Taka 56,25,000 in anticipation of shares of full value but because of limitation in shares the applicant company issued shares worth Taka 25,00,000 and refunded Taka 31,25,000 in the following year and as such being no abstract of balance it could not be reflected in the balance sheet of Grameen Byabosha Bikash?"
